WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate) AS avg_rental_rate, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
), ratios AS (
  SELECT rating, avg_rental_rate / avg_replacement_cost AS ratio_of_averages, film_count
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT rating, ratio_of_averages, film_count,
       ratio_of_averages - (SELECT AVG(ratio_of_averages) FROM ratios) AS difference_from_plain_average
FROM ratios;
